assets.name: Sage_AI System Context
assets.notes: Fifth release. The system instructions as in the library on 11/16/2026. Both plugins are tested. The plugins cannot trigger the refresh of a linked table, so Sage_AI lists the documents that embed it and asks the Product Owner to refresh each one. No script applies edits to a Document. The Sage_AI Doc Edits skill and the Sage_AI Edits script are retired and removed from the repository. The 20261114 and 20261112 files stay as history.
